items.title: Precision Retrieval for Regulated Industries with Vespa.ai on AWS
items.summary: Enterprise AI succeeds or fails on whether the right context reaches the model. This post looks at two regulated domains, life sciences and financial services, where an irrelevant answer slows a clinical trial or undermines an analyst's conclusion. It shows why the winning pattern on AWS is use-case led: retrieve with hybrid signals, rank with domain logic, and serve in real time. See how Reveal HealthTech and RavenPack build precision retrieval and RAG with Vespa.ai.
items.creator: Parascovia Digori
